title: DDPM crystal sampler with per-step scalar sync and fragmented time embedding
authoring_note: Positive SciML generation task. Baseline uses .item() schedule reads, per-step fragmented time embedding, and a one-crystal-at-a-time sampling loop. Reference fix precomputes schedules, fuses the embedding, and batches the loop. Time-to-quality is wall-clock to reach 0.9 validity on a seeded eval batch.
author: batch-C prototype agent
